BBC — published 23 Sep 2026 15:35 BST
Headline: Trump reveals millions of dollars' worth of share deals in big tech and AI

US President Donald Trump has disclosed millions of dollars' worth of stock market trades made during July, including in firms from Elon Musk's SpaceX to tech and AI giants such as Microsoft.

According to official documents, between $6.5m (£4.8m) and $31m worth of stock in Microsoft was sold on behalf of Trump, while they show purchases of between $165,000 and $400,000.

Across more than 1,000 trades, shares were bought and sold in AI company Nvidia and software firm Palantir, a contractor with the US defence department and Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE), the filing shows.

A White House spokesperson said Trump's stock and bond portfolio is independently managed by third parties. The spokesperson told the BBC: "Neither President Trump nor any member of his family has any ability to direct, influence or provide input regarding how the portfolio is invested or when investments are bought or sold. There are no conflicts of interest."

According to the filing, thousands of dollars' worth of stock was also bought and sold in SpaceX, the rocket, satellite and AI company led by Musk. SpaceX listed its shares on the US-based Nasdaq stock market in June. Its share price has fluctuated since then, sharply declining in July and August, but it is currently trading 14% higher than its stock market debut.

Shares were also bought and sold in Tesla, Musk's electric vehicle-maker, on behalf of Trump. Trump has previously publicly disclosed thousands of stock market trades since he returned to the White House in January last year.

--- Reuters, 22 Sep 19:49 BST (https://www.reuters.com/legal/government/trump-bought-sold-shares-musks-spacex-july-financial-disclosure-shows-2026-09-22/): Trump bought between $15,001 and $50,000 worth of shares in SpaceX on July 10, according to a financial disclosure he signed on September 8. He sold between $1,001 and $15,000 worth of shares on July 17. The purchase and sale were among more than 1,000 trades the president made in July. The Office of Government Ethics posted the form on its website on Tuesday.

--- CNBC, 22 Sep 18:42 BST (https://www.cnbc.com/2026/09/22/trump-trades-microsoft-amazon-july-financial-disclosure.html): 1,156 securities transactions in July totaling between roughly $79 million and $270 million, CNBC calculated. Largest were sales of between $5 million and $25 million each of Microsoft and Amazon on July 20. Purchases totaled at least $43.6 million, sales at least $35.6 million. In June, Trump disclosed 1,051 transactions totaling between $78.1 million and $263.1 million.

--- Guardian, 22 Sep 21:42 BST (https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/sep/22/trump-stock-trades-july-filing): more than 440 purchases and 700 sales; sold up to $5m of Oracle and Costco, $500,000 to $1m in Nvidia, bought up to $5m in Intuit and Salesforce on 20 July.

NOTE: story broke Tuesday evening BST (OGE posting); BBC write-up is Wednesday 15:35 BST. Marginal for GEO column — US domestic/ethics story.
